Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence

Class JdbcTimestamps

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.JdbcTimestamps
public final class JdbcTimestamps extends Object
Converts between the domain's Instant and the OffsetDateTime the PostgreSQL driver binds to and reads from a timestamp with time zone column. Shared by every JDBC adapter of this module, so they all store UTC values the same way.
